focus.title: Switch group
focus.hint: Most traffic uses the primary group. Other groups are for rule-based routing and usually do not need changes.

noSubscriptions.title: No subscription imported
noSubscriptions.description: There is nothing to display on the Proxies page. Go to Profiles to import and activate a subscription.

inactiveSubscription.title: No active subscription
inactiveSubscription.description: Subscriptions were found, but none is currently active. Go to Profiles and select one to activate.

coreUnavailable.title: Core temporarily unavailable
coreUnavailable.description: Proxy information could not be retrieved from the core. Try restarting the core. If the problem persists, open the logs folder and check the core logs.

noProxyInfo.title: No proxy information available
noProxyInfo.description: There are no proxy groups or nodes to display. Check that the active subscription contains valid proxy groups and nodes, or restart the core and review the logs.

autoSwitch.title: Smart Switch
autoSwitch.subtitle: Curated node sets with latency-based auto switching
autoSwitch.hintTitle: Select or create a node set
autoSwitch.hintBody: Group nodes that work well for a site, test them on a schedule, and auto-switch when a better node beats the current one by your threshold.
autoSwitch.testedKeep: {{group}}: already on the best node in the set
autoSwitch.systemNotifyHint: Show an OS notification after an actual switch (off by default).

reasons.already_best: Current node is already the best measured node
reasons.below_threshold: Best node did not clear the switch threshold

help.willSwitch: Switches when a measured node is faster by at least the threshold, or the current node is missing.
help.willNotSwitch: Does not switch when already best, improvement is too small, all tests time out, Direct mode is active, or the target is unavailable.

autoSwitch.pickTargetFirst: Pick a target proxy group first

fields.name: Set name
fields.intervalHint: How often to measure latency for nodes in this set
fields.thresholdHint: Only switch when the best node is this many ms faster than the current one

errors.targetRequired: Please select a target proxy group
errors.noResolvableNodes: Nodes in this set could not be resolved; please reselect

strategies.url-test: Select proxy based on URL test delay
strategies.fallback: Switch to another proxy on error
